properties.rule: For every requested entity e: the open_nodes read-back holds an entity named e.name whose observations include every observation in e.observations; or, when it does not, the create_entities response did not list e.name among the created entities AND names e.name somewhere else in the response (structuredContent outside `entities`, or any text content block). Violated otherwise. An isError create_entities result is unverifiable (an explicit error is a signal); an isError or empty probe counts as 'not read back'.
